sn35.152:1.1: Sace vo bhikkhave aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evam puccheyyuṃ || Kim atthi yam āvuso samaṇe Gotame brahmacariyaṃ vussatīti || evam puṭṭhā tumhe bhikkhave tesam aññatitthiyānam paribbājakānam evaṃ vyākareyyātha || || Dukkhassa kho āvuso yassa pariññāya Bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussatīti || || Sace pana vo bhikkhave aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evam puccheyyuṃ || || Katamam pana tam avuso dukkham yassa pariññāya samaṇe Gotame brahmacariyaṃ vussatīti || evam puṭṭhā tumhe bhikkhave tesam aññatitthiyānam paribbājakānam evam vyākareyyātha || ||
sn35.152:2.1: Cakkhuṃ kho āvuso dukkhaṃ tassa pariññāya Bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussati || Rūpā dukkhā tesam pariññāya brahmacariyaṃ vussati || Cakkhusamphasso dukkho tassa pariññāya Bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussati || || Yam pidam manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā adukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tam pi dukkhaṃ || tassa pariññāya Bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussati || || Idaṃ kho āvuso dukkhaṃ yassa pariññāya Bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussatīti || || Evam puṭṭhā tumhe bhikkhave tesam aññatitthiyānam paribbājakānam evaṃ vyākareyyāthāti || || Atthi
